caption: Check the version before reaching for an old trace flag.

code:
Lock Pages in Memory (LPIM)
  right: SeLockMemoryPrivilege
  stops the OS trimming SQL Server's memory

Instant File Initialization (IFI)
  right: SeManageVolumePrivilege
  skips zero-fill on DATA file growth only

Both granted via secpol.msc, not sp_configure.
Both need a SQL Server service restart.
caption: Windows-level rights on the service account -- not a T-SQL setting.
